scope: Self player: walk, sit/stand, outdoor recline, hold/read/put down book, grip/drink/return cup, first/third switch, field audio and MiniMax output
limits: Screenshots and joint/contact checks do not prove every possible camera angle is free of minor clothing artifacts.
